method: Fresh full official collector-guide web read. Normalized factual snapshot, not a raw HTML hash. Card identities are joined only after checking literal workbook families, numbers and names; no facts are taken from image OCR.

baseProgram.scope: The Base Set section and Key Facts explicitly cover the 300-card base program. Other autograph, insert and relic programs are outside this family-wide statement.

cardExamples: Only the pictured Danhausen base example; the prose names no parallel. No Red Magma or other color join is inferred.
Berto example only; do not number other subjects or all Black Portal categories.
Stephanie Vaquer example only; do not number other subjects or all Black Portal categories.
The named ZaRUCA dual-card example only; both printed signers remain attached.
Liv Morgan example only; no family-wide autograph or relic limit is inferred.
Tiffany Stratton example only; the guide also describes an It's Tiffy Time! inscription. No family-wide limit is inferred.
normalizedFacts.firstInPackExample: Danhausen; this statement does not establish a Rookie flag.
normalizedFacts.releaseDateQualification: Article publication is not a calendar release statement.

exactOddsAliases.BASE: BASE CARDS I / BASE CARDS II

exactOddsAliases.\"STONE COLD\" STEVE AUSTIN 30TH ANNIVER: STONE COLD STEVE AUSTIN 30TH ANNIVERSARY AUTOGRAPHS

remainingGaps: The guide does not publish a complete numeric ladder for every color or program. Exhaustive parallel numbering and individual-card eligibility remain unverified.
Danhausen’s five-copy example names no color in the prose. Berto, Stephanie Vaquer, ZaRUCA, Liv Morgan and Tiffany Stratton limits remain isolated to the exact named cards.
Box configuration, article date and available-now wording do not establish general release date or odds units. The odds sheet’s ratio unit remains unstated.
